overview_description.description: Guesty is a property management platform that provides end-to-end property management software for short-term rentals. The Guesty platform provides property managers and management companies with an end-to-end solution to simplify the complex operational needs of short-term rentals. With Guesty, users across the globe can seamlessly manage listings from multiple online travel agencies including Airbnb, Booking.com, Agoda and more, by utilizing the company’s advanced tools which include: Channel Manager, Unified Inbox, Multi-Calendar, Mobile Management App, Automation Tools, 24/7 Guest Communication Services, Payment Processing, Owners Portal and more.

about_short_description.short_description: Guesty’s advanced technology optimizes, automates, and streamlines every aspect of managing a hospitality business, all from one platform.

product.name: Guesty Platform
product.description: An AI-powered vacation rental property management platform for managing reservations, listings, guest communication, operations, payments, and performance across short-term rental portfolios.

product.name: Guesty AI Suite
product.description: A collection of AI agents and automation capabilities for guest messaging, revenue optimization, financial administration, review management, fraud screening, listing content, and data analysis.

product.name: Guesty Lite
product.description: A Guesty plan for hosts and property managers with 1–3 listings, providing channel synchronization, guest messaging, automated workflows, task management, and direct booking capabilities.

product.name: Guesty Pro
product.description: A property management solution for professional operators managing approximately 4–199 listings, with centralized operations, AI automation, distribution, guest experience, reporting, and revenue tools.

product.name: Guesty Enterprise
product.description: A customizable Guesty solution for operators managing 200 or more listings, with enterprise portfolio management, tailored workflows, AI agents, revenue optimization, and open API access.

product.name: Guesty Channel Manager
product.description: A distribution system that synchronizes listings, availability, reservations, and pricing across Airbnb, Vrbo, Booking.com, and more than 60 booking channels.
